examples.reason: Subtype root and semantic consequence both match StructureEvent.
Subtype declares observed measurement semantics and fits ObservationEvent.
Subtype encodes non-deliberate damage semantics and fits OccurrenceEvent.
Subtype encodes deliberate human action and fits InterventionEvent.
Subtype encodes lot identity and custody change semantics and fits MaterialEvent.
Subtype encodes evidentiary capture and linkage semantics and fits EvidenceEvent.
Subtype encodes formal review/closure semantics and fits GovernanceEvent.
Deliberate irrigation action cannot be re-labeled as MaterialEvent by private interpretation.
Lot custody/identity change cannot be silently flattened into InterventionEvent.
Pack attempts to bind an occurrence-rooted subtype under ObservationEvent; ambiguous dominant consequence is not auto-accepted.
Packs may add subtypes but may not invent new top-level event families without governance.

measurementClassInterpretations.meaning: Collection history and protocol/specimen support; pending analysis does not erase the collection.
Acquisition of the exact observed property on the stated support, not generic intervention performance.
Analytical result about its specimen, matrix/analyte and method; sampling, analysis and issue times stay distinct.
Instrument observation with calibration/provenance and actual phenomenon instant or interval; a reading does not prove an actuator was operated.
Attributed human assessment with its method and uncertainty; observation versus inference must be typed.
Interpreted image content with spatial support, acquisition/interpretation time distinction and method limits.
Derived remotely sensed property with support/processing provenance; not automatically local operation performance.
Imported process measurement with source/timelog/equipment binding; exchange format is not accepted execution.
Attributed external statement about the exact subject/property; authenticity and use eligibility stay with evidence owners.
